user.title: Login to your edupage account

two_factor.title: Two-Factor Authentication
two_factor.description:
EduPage requires a second factor for this account.

Enter the confirmation code from the EduPage mobile app. If you cannot reach the app, you can instead ask EduPage to send the code to your email address, to resend the app notification, or to confirm that you have already approved this login in the app.

The email address on file is `{email}`, and the paired devices are `{devices}`.

EduPage limits how often a code can be requested. If a request is rejected, wait {retry_seconds} seconds before trying again.
